page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg9i.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated Intel Xeon 6982P-C vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This server configuration does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps to support external data transfers and cloud storage connectivity. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this instance type.

With its dedicated high-frequency Intel Xeon processor and standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.hfg9i.4xlarge offers a reliable hardware profile for general-purpose workloads, application servers, and moderate database hosting. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient choice for workloads requiring stable CPU performance without the overhead of specialized accelerator hardware.
